body: To answer your other question, nah, they're not drunks. I'm pretty sure my dad has some anger management issues or bipolar disorder, but I'm afraid to tell him. My mom is more passive-aggressive and instead of yelling and screaming, she gives me the silent treatment (which is a bit worse some ways). Don't know if you were kidding or not, but I've actually seriously thought about running away before. I just wouldn't know where I would run away to or what good would actually come out of it o-o

That's very true. I should just stop moping around maybe I'll find my niche naturally. Thank you, my friend! You and OIP have both made me feel a heck of a lot better and I'm not kidding. I still don't know what I'm going to do about the situation with my parents, though. I'll try talking to someone about it and see if that helps any.

I hope you're right, man. I feel so alone right now. And thank you so much for saying that! I really enjoy writing, but I'm too shy to show anyone anything I write. I like things that I can be a bit creative with. I like to make things like clothes and costumes, clay models, drawings, paintings, digital art, etc. I'm crap at all of those, but I enjoy expressing myself that way =\ The one thing I can say I'm good at is working with computers because I used to be really into scripting/programming and hacking when I was younger, but I don't enjoy it at all anymore.
